faq.a: Norliza is associated with the Arabic form نُورْ لِيزَا, whose core sense is norliza; light of liza (malay form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Norliza?
faq.a: Norliza is associated with Arabic. Norliza is a Malay compound of Arabic نُور (nūr, 'light') + the name Liza.
Yes — the underlying form نُورْ لِيزَا is Arabic.
Norliza can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Norliza should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Nūr occurs in the Quran as a term for light.

faq.q: What does Norliza mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Norliza is rendered نور لیزا and carries the sense نور لیزا، لیزا کی روشنی.

faq.q: What does Norliza mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Norliza is rendered نور لیزا and carries the sense نور لیزا، نور لیزا.
A romanized syllable approximation is nor-li-za. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Norliza?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Norliza, norliza. Script forms are نور ليزا, نور لیزا, نُورْ لِيزَا, नूर लीज़ा.

faq.q: Is Norliza a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
